checks.name: Match case + "GOLF" narrows to 1/1 exact-case match
Replace all golf->tango rewrites all 3 hits in the flat HTML (0 golf left)
Replace (single) rewrites exactly one match (3 tango -> 1 lima + 2 tango)

declaredGaps: OO ships Find & replace as a full right panel with more-options (whole words, regex, look up); the committed OO DIALOG census captured no field-level find modal — the field contract is pinned from the MS-Word-style Find & Replace shape (Find, Replace with, Match case, Previous/Next, Replace, Replace All)
OO/MS extras (whole words only, sounds-like, regex, search-direction scope) are deferred by WO — recorded divergence, not gated

contract.title: Find and replace
contract.behavior: live match count (current / total, case-insensitive; Match case narrows); Replace all rewrites every hit into the flat HTML as ONE undoable step; Replace rewrites the current match; Close leaves the document untouched
